$comment: fmt and spdlog are intentionally NOT listed here. They are sourced from conda (alongside PDAL) so all three stay ABI-compatible; mixing a vcpkg fmt with conda's PDAL (which links its own fmt) caused symbol-mismatch failures on Windows. The CMake configure step in .github/workflows/build-{linux,windows}.yml adds the conda prefix to CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH so find_package(fmt) and the spdlog headers are resolved from there.
